easyPrerequisites: Hostage Taker must be exiled by Changeling Titan, and Yannik must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
description:
Cast Yannik for its mana cost.
When Yannik enters, it exiles Changeling Titan until Yannik leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Yannik's ETB.
When Changeling Titan leaves the battlefield, Hostage Taker is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Hostage Taker enters, it exiles Yannik until Hostage Taker leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Hostage Taker's ETB.
When Yannik leaves the battlefield, Changeling Titan is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Changeling Titan enters, it exiles Hostage Taker until Changeling Titan leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Changeling Titan's ETB.
When Hostage Taker leaves the battlefield, Yannik is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
